_comment: Vibe-app attacker/proposer pair (prompts/vibe-app-attacker.md, prompts/vibe-app-proposer.md). Both roles are Claude via OpenRouter (one OPENROUTER_API_KEY) — same family, so you will see the decorrelation warning; point either block at a different vendor id, or pass --tier frontier|good|open, for a cross-vendor pair. Run: `node orchestrate.mjs --mode vibe-app --config agents.vibeapp.json --task "..."` (or --file). Converges when the attacker's strongest standing finding is at/below --floor (default LOW).
